description: Grafana Alerting default Slack message grouping two firing alerts of one rule (two crash-looping pods). The group key must use only the labels both alerts share.
provenance: Same default templates as grafana_firing: __subject shows the group label values (alertname, grafana_folder) and the common labels in parentheses; the common GeneratorURL becomes title_link; no dashboard annotation, so no Dashboard/Panel lines.
